title: Fill the pet water bowl

steps.tip: Dump old water in the sink if it looks dusty.
A quick swirl is enough unless it is slimy — then ask a grown-up.

steps.text: Fill with fresh water and set it down in the usual spot.
steps.tip: Do not overfill. Leave a little space at the top.

done_when: Bowl is in its usual place, not dripping a trail
parent_notes: Food portions stay a grown-up job unless you add a later chore. Watch for heavy ceramic bowls.
